learner_level: medical students, interns and specialty trainees; adapt depth to the selected learner stage
description: A comprehensive pathology and laboratory medicine curriculum blueprint spanning foundational knowledge, clinical assessment, major disease groups, emergencies, investigations, treatment principles, procedures and professional practice. This is a structured draft for faculty mapping and review, not a substitute for an applicable national curriculum or local examination specification.

source_families.role: revision coverage and exam phrasing; not clinical authority
free interactive challenge themes and exam practice; verify access and reuse terms
open-access clinical studies, reviews and case reports; appraise methods and relevance
research discovery, abstracts and eligible open full text
exam structure, clinical skills and learning explanations

examples: Relevant international and national specialty societies
source_families.role: clinical recommendations and standards; check jurisdiction and current version

source_discovery_policy.matching_policy: Search each topic and each stable objective separately. Store metadata, canonical links, dates, identifiers, access and licence status, matched topic/objective IDs, retrieval date and review status. Link-only discovery is not evidence coverage.
source_discovery_policy.rights_policy: Default to metadata and links. Do not copy decks, challenge questions, journal text, figures or explanations unless the licence or explicit permission allows it. Public access is not a reuse licence.
source_discovery_policy.evidence_policy: Anki decks, challenge sites and exam-preparation sites are learning signals, not clinical evidence. Clinical claims require current authoritative sources and qualified faculty review.
